newsitem.title: UK: UK set to sign Canadian landmines pact - sources.
newsitem.headline: UK set to sign Canadian landmines pact - sources.

text.p: Britain is expected to announce on Wednesdady it will sign up to a Canadian initiative to ban landmines in what would be a major policy change, diplomatic sources said.

Britain had previously shown little interest in signing up to the so-called Ottawa Process, which groups around 50 nations who want to conclude an official treaty by the end of the year to ban the use of mines.
But the sources said the new Labour government -- which has stressed the importance of human rights - had decided it should take part, and would make an announcemenet at 1430 GMT.
Landmines are blamed for killing 25,000 people a year and maiming many more.
The United States said last week it would not sign up to the Ottawa Process because China and Russia -- major producers and users of landmines -- are not members.
Many Western diplomats say a viable, universal ban on landmines can only be concluded at the Geneva-based Conference on Disarmament, where the issue has yet to get off the ground.

The diplomats say Mexico -- a leading member of the non-aligned movement -- has blocked the launch of talks on landmines because it prefers the ban to be negotiated under the auspices of the Ottawa Process.
